name: Shannon Algeo
reason: His work is now mainly psychotherapy (his website is a therapy practice for California clients, with a therapy request form and rates) and attachment-based work on smartphone use framed as phone addiction and digital detox; his Esalen programme (14 to 18 Dec 2026) is built on attachment styles, re-parenting and poetry therapy, and his recent videos are almost all addiction-framed interviews. Skipped under the therapy and health rules; his earlier Yoga Nidra and chakra book (Trust Your Truth) is the only clearly spiritual strand.
